credits.overview: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

credits.title: Lucky Baskhar
credits.overview: A middle-class bank clerk who longs to trade stability for adventure gets more than he bargained for when he unexpectedly becomes a wealthy man.

credits.title: Pellikuturu Party
credits.overview: A seductive younger sister who tries to sabotage the marriage of her conservative older sister by going on a bachelorette road trip while being chaperoned by their reluctant grandmother.
